items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So we did that, and Leonard Feather played that back to me, expecting I don’t know what. I started laughing.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know what you’re talking about. Leonard Feather, he had a column in Downbeat called “Blindfold Test” and I did it once. What was the record though?
He played the Bobby Sherwood one.
